Deprecated packages: NONE detected (expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch not in package.json). Two MINOR issues discovered — see below.

ui_bugs.issue: Inbox rows for the new BATTLE_RESOLVED event (emitted by backend/app/domain/caravans.py:426 after INTERCEPT resolution) fall into the default describe() branch and render the raw payload as JSON: '{"battle_id":"btl_mar_...","march_id":"mar_...","winne'. Root cause: frontend/app/(tabs)/inbox.tsx describe() has cases for BATTLE_REPORT_READY but not BATTLE_RESOLVED (line 55-92). Fix: add a case for BATTLE_RESOLVED returning localized 'Battaglia risolta · <mission> · <winner> · Bottino <cargoLine(loot)>' or similar.

Tapping a BATTLE_RESOLVED inbox row does nothing because open() (frontend/app/(tabs)/inbox.tsx:95-104) only routes to /battle/[id] for event==='BATTLE_REPORT_READY', and the deep_link 'battle/<id>' matches no other prefix (research/caravans/map/army/settlement/missions). Fix: extend the branch to also match n.event==='BATTLE_RESOLVED' OR match deep_link?.startsWith('battle/'). The Reports tab still surfaces the underlying battle via battle-item-<id> so the report is reachable, but the Inbox row itself is a dead-tap.

action_items: MINOR: Add BATTLE_RESOLVED handling to frontend/app/(tabs)/inbox.tsx describe() so the row shows a localized summary instead of raw JSON. Suggested: `case 'BATTLE_RESOLVED': return `${t('battleResolved')} · ${p.mission} · ${p.winner} · ${cargoLine(p.loot, lang) || '—'}`;` (add battleResolved key to i18n).
MINOR: Extend open() in the same file to route BATTLE_RESOLVED taps to /battle/[id] using n.payload?.battle_id (or generalise deep_link.startsWith('battle/')).

OBS: caravan-new-submit works, but if the caravan-new screen is entered via a deep-link with no history stack, router.back() after submit logs a benign console error 'The action GO_BACK was not handled by any navigator'. In real user flow (hub → composer) this is fine; consider router.replace('/caravans') or router.canGoBack() ? back() : replace() as a defensive fix.

rca_of_issue: BATTLE_RESOLVED regression RCA — Symptom: Inbox row body shows raw JSON `{"battle_id":"btl_mar_79b1bb77f94a4564",...}`. Repro: complete an INTERCEPT battle (either wait for the interceptor to arrive or use the previous interceptor already resolved in this world) → open tab-inbox → find a row labelled 'BATTLE RESOLVED'. Root cause: two-part. (a) frontend/app/(tabs)/inbox.tsx describe() switch does not include BATTLE_RESOLVED; falls to default = JSON.stringify(payload).slice(0,80). (b) frontend/app/(tabs)/inbox.tsx open() routes to /battle/[id] only for event === 'BATTLE_REPORT_READY'; deep_link 'battle/<id>' doesn't match any startsWith prefix, so the row is a dead tap. Backend has been emitting BATTLE_RESOLVED specifically for INTERCEPT battles (caravans.py:426) since caravans landed, but frontend was not updated. Mitigation: add BATTLE_RESOLVED case to describe() + extend open() with either `if (n.event === 'BATTLE_RESOLVED' && n.payload?.battle_id) router.push(...)` or a `deep_link?.startsWith('battle/')` branch. Impact is cosmetic — the Reports tab still exposes battle reports via battle-item-<id>.
